title: Specs

readonly.title: You can't write to this folder
readonly.body: Specs are view-only. Editing, changing states and running work when the folder is writable.

unavailable.title: The project integration that stores specs is off
unavailable.body: Specs are stored in the project folder. Until you turn the integration on, the app doesn't create them in its own store instead.

problem.folderMissing: Can't show specs: the project folder wasn't found
problem.manifestInvalid: Can't show specs: the project settings file can't be read
problem.configReadonly: Can't edit specs: you can't write to this folder

runsOff: The runs integration is off, so tasks can't run

list.emptyBody: A spec is a set of documents stored in this project folder. Create one from a template, or import documents from the folder.

new.title: New spec
new.name: Name
new.noTemplates: This project has no templates. Copy one from the shared library, or start with a blank spec.
new.haveFolder: Already have documents in a folder?

import.title: Import spec from folder
import.intro: Copies Markdown documents in the project folder into a new spec. They aren't linked to the originals.
import.folder: Folder (path relative to the project folder)
import.folderHint: If empty, it's directly under the project folder
import.noFiles: This folder has no Markdown documents
import.name: Name
import.truncated: There are many files, so only some are shown
import.remote: The server is open from a computer other than this one, so the folder's file list can't be shown

export.title: Export documents
export.folder: Target folder (path relative to the project folder)
export.overwrite: Overwrite files with the same name
export.overwriteWarn: The content of files with the same name in the target is lost.
export.note: After copying, the two are independent. There's no automatic sync.

delete.title: Delete spec “{name}”
delete.body: The document files in the {path} folder are deleted. Runs started from this spec stay in the run history. If you committed the files to git, you can restore them from git.
delete.bodyRoot: The spec's document files are deleted. Runs started from this spec stay in the run history. If you committed the files to git, you can restore them from git.

doc.listFooter: Edit the document list on the Rules tab
doc.noDocsAction: Add a document on the Rules tab
doc.noTransition: No transitions a person can make
doc.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text in the editor and copy it yourself.
doc.reloadBody: Unsaved changes to this document are lost. You can keep them first with [Copy my changes].
doc.overwriteBody: Changes made elsewhere are replaced by yours.
doc.secretSuspect_one: Something looks like a secret in {count} place.
doc.secretSuspect_other: Something looks like a secret in {count} places.
doc.secretSuspectAt_one: Something looks like a secret in {count} place (lines {lines}).
doc.secretSuspectAt_other: Something looks like a secret in {count} places (lines {lines}).
doc.secretRejected: Couldn't save: something looks like a secret
doc.secretRejectedAt: Couldn't save: something looks like a secret (lines {lines})

tasks.fieldNone: No fields appear in the tasks
tasks.statusFail409: The “{title}” line changed elsewhere, so the state couldn't be changed
tasks.blockedWrite: You can't write to this folder, so you can't change states

syntaxMissing.title: No task syntax
syntaxMissing.body: The default task syntax is off and this spec has no task syntax rule. To see tasks, plan and trace, set a task syntax in the rules. Editing documents and changing states still work.

empty.title: No tasks
empty.body: Task lines you write in the task document appear here. You can see the current syntax on the Rules tab.

rules.readonlyTop: You can't write to this folder, so you can't edit the rules
rules.conflictBody: This spec's rules were changed elsewhere. Load the latest content, or overwrite with your changes.
rules.syntaxSource: Source of the task syntax values
rules.documentsHint: Edit the document list and rules in the form below. Edit document content on the Documents tab.

widgets.regexHint: The server checks the regular expression. A moment after you stop typing, the result appears below.
widgets.refDirect: If it isn't in the list, you can enter it yourself
widgets.refMissingGraph: This project has no team “{id}” — it's copied in when you run
widgets.refUnknownList: The list can't load, so you can only enter it yourself
widgets.unknownShape: The format is unknown, so enter it as JSON

saveTemplate.title: Save as template
saveTemplate.name: Template name
saveTemplate.idReserved: This name is reserved. Enter another id
saveTemplate.contentInclude: Include the current content as the skeleton
saveTemplate.conflict: If the same id already exists
saveTemplate.note: After copying, the two are independent.

templates.title: Templates
templates.emptyBody: A template fills in the document list and rules when you create a spec. Use “Save as template” on a project's documents.
templates.pickOne: Choose a template from the list

off.title: Templates aren't available
off.body: The shared library (the definitions feature) is off, so the screen for creating and editing templates isn't available. Templates inside a project still show when you create a new spec.

run.none: No actions are available for this task
run.gateAtHead: A gate is blocking the run

bulk.title: Starting {m} of the {n} selected tasks
bulk.hint: After they start, each task is recorded separately in the run history.
bulk.limit_one: You can start up to {count} at a time
bulk.limit_other: You can start up to {count} at a time

plan.tooBig: There are {n} tasks, so the graph isn't drawn. Use the batch list beside it.

trace.emptyBody: The requirement documents have no lines that match the requirement id rule.
trace.orphanUnknownTaskHint: When a task id changes, its old runs stay here.

automation.status: Auto-advance on · Runs in progress {a} · Skipped {s}
automation.confirmBody: As soon as a task finishes, ready tasks start automatically, {parallelText}. A task is skipped after it fails {failuresText} in a row. Runs that cost money may start without anyone present.
automation.failuresUnset: as many times as you've set

reasons.spec_done: All of the spec's tasks are done
reasons.failures: Reached the limit of consecutive failures

leave.title: You have unsaved changes
leave.body: If you leave now, your edits are lost.

noProject: Choose a project to see its specs

template.libraryNote: This is a shared template. You can pick it when you create a new spec in any project.

empty.title: No templates
empty.body: A template fills in the document list and rules when you create a spec. Create one yourself, or use “Save as template” on a project's documents.
empty.hint: You can create one with [New template] at the top.

create.title: New template
create.name: Name
create.idReserved: This name is reserved. Enter another id
create.hint: Creates an empty template with no documents and opens the editor.

editor.readonly: This template is view-only. You can edit it when it's writable.
editor.conflictBody: This template was changed elsewhere. Load the latest content, or overwrite with your changes.

files.noDocuments: This template has no documents. Add one on the Rules tab and it's linked here.

versions.note: This server doesn't support comparing template versions. You can only revert and view the raw content.

delete.title: Delete template “{name}”
delete.body: Specs you already created aren't affected. You can bring the template back from its version history.

template.picked: Choose a template from the list

no_run.label: No run
no_run.hint: The linked task hasn't run yet.

task_not_done.label: Task not done
task_not_done.hint: The linked task isn't finished yet.
